responsibility: This header defines the `neoversev3ae_tunings` model for Arm Neoverse V3AE in the AArch64 backend. It closely mirrors the V3 family structure but packages its own register-move, AdvSIMD/SVE vector, and issue-resource data with Armv9 `tune_params`, giving GCC a distinct automotive/embedded Neoverse V3AE tuning profile rather than treating it as identical to generic V3.
